description: Look up ABAP repository objects (DB tables, CDS view entities, function modules, classes, interfaces, …) in SAP's published ABAP Cloudification list and report, per object, whether it is a 'released' API (safe to use in ABAP Cloud / Clean Core), 'deprecated' (released but being retired), or 'not-released' (a classic/internal object that is not a public API — e.g. most classic DDIC tables) — with SAP's own successor(s) when the snapshot has any, a curated CDS successor hint otherwise, and a classicAPI/noAPI/internalAPI classification where SAP publishes one. This reflects SAP's official per-edition Cloudification lists as bundled in this package (default edition "s4hc", snapshot 2026-10-26); it ships offline with the server. Use this when you need to know if your code may reference a given object in ABAP Cloud, or which released CDS view to use instead of a classic table. This explicit lookup complements check_cloud_readiness's limited, source-extracted released-API observations and can check objects that do not appear in the supplied source. It does not connect to any SAP system, does not run ATC, and is only as current as the bundled snapshot — a target system's own released-API ATC check ("Usage of Released APIs (Cloudification Repository)" for SAP Cloud ERP Public Edition / "Usage of APIs (Cloudification Repository)" for SAP Cloud ERP Private Edition / on-premise, via variants such as ABAP_CLEAN_CORE_DEVELOPMENT / ABAP_CLEAN_CORE_READINESS) remains authoritative; treat an 'absent from the list' result as 'not-released as of the snapshot', not as proof. Example: check_released_api({ "objects": ["MARA", "I_Product", "BAPI_MATERIAL_GET_DETAIL"] }).

edition.description: SAP edition of the bundled Cloudification snapshot to check against: "s4hc" (default, SAP Cloud ERP Public Edition), "btp" (SAP BTP ABAP environment), or "pce" (SAP Cloud ERP Private Edition / on-premise). Release state and successors can differ by edition — the same object may be released in one and not yet in another.

objects.description: Objects to check, 1–200 per call. Each is a bare name string or a { name, type? } object, e.g. ["MARA", { "name": "I_Product", "type": "CDS_STOB" }].

anyOf.description: A bare object name, e.g. "MARA" or "I_Product".

type.description: Optional SAP object type to disambiguate same-named objects: "TABL" (table), "CDS_STOB" (CDS view entity), "FUNC" (function module), "CLAS", "INTF", "BDEF". Omit if unsure.

name: check_released_api

edition.description: SAP edition these results were checked against.

applicationComponent.description: Owning application component of the matched record, if found.

classification.description: SAP's classicAPI/noAPI/internalAPI classification for this object, from objectClassifications_SAP.json, when recorded.

objectType.description: SAP object type of the matched record (TABL, CDS_STOB, FUNC, …), if found.

recorded.description: true = explicitly present in SAP's snapshot (under the requested type, if one was given); false = absent — 'not released as of the snapshot' by omission only.

state.description: 'released' = safe public API; 'deprecated' = retiring; 'not-released' = not a public API.

successor.description: Released successor for a deprecated/classic object, when one is known — SAP's own, or the curated fallback (see successorSource).

successorSource.description: Where `successor` came from: SAP's own snapshot data, the curated table-successors fallback, or none available.

successors.description: Every SAP-published successor object for this record (there can be more than one), when the snapshot carries any.

snapshotDate.description: Date of the bundled SAP Cloudification snapshot these results reflect.

source.description: URL of the SAP Apache-2.0 source the snapshot was built from.

title: Check ABAP released-API status
